trips.title: Dublin and the Irish Coast
trips.summary:
From the charm of Dublin to the dramatic
coastline of the Giant’s Causeway, this trip
blends iconic sights with authentic experiences.
trips.intro:
Experience the beauty of Ireland on a 7-day
journey through stunning landscapes and rich
culture.

From the charm of Dublin to the dramatic
coastline of the Giant’s Causeway, this trip
blends iconic sights with authentic experiences.

Relax, explore, and enjoy Ireland—without the
stress of planning.
highlights: Giant’s Causeway and  Dark Hedges visits

itinerary.title: Welcome to Dublin
itinerary.body:
Arrive in Dublin and meet your private driver for transfer to your hotel. After settling in,
connect with your group over welcome drinks and dinner as your Ireland journey
begins.

itinerary.title: Dublin Highlights
itinerary.body:
Set out on a guided exploration of Dublin’s history and culture. Visit Trinity
College, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, and Dublin Castle, then stroll along Grafton
Street. Enjoy a classic Irish meal and finish the day with a perfectly poured pint
of Guinness.

itinerary.title: Explore at Your Leisure
itinerary.body:
Enjoy a full day in Dublin at your own pace. Start with breakfast at the hotel, then
spend the day however you choose—shopping along Grafton Street, relaxing in
St. Stephen’s Green, or exploring the city’s museums and galleries. Lunch and
dinner are on your own today, giving you the freedom to experience Dublin your
way.

itinerary.title: Northern Coast Journey
itinerary.body:
Depart Dublin and travel north through scenic countryside toward the coast.
Stop at the iconic Dark Hedges, then continue to the breathtaking Giant’s
Causeway to explore its unique coastal formations. End the day in Bushmills,
where you’ll settle into your accommodations for the evening.

itinerary.title: Bushmills at Your Leisure
itinerary.body:
Start your day with breakfast at the hotel, then enjoy a full day in Bushmills at
your own pace. Visit the Old Bushmills Distillery, explore the dramatic ruins of
Dunluce Castle, or take in the coastal views at Whiterocks Beach.

Lunch and dinner are on your own today, giving you the freedom to explore and
enjoy the area however you choose.

itinerary.title: Coastal Adventure & Farewell
itinerary.body:
Take in the beauty of Ireland’s northern coastline with a walk to the Carrick-a-
Rede Rope Bridge, where dramatic cliffs and ocean views set the scene.
Afterward, travel back to Dublin and enjoy a farewell dinner with the group,
celebrating the journey and memories made.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body:
Enjoy one last morning in Dublin before heading to the airport for your flight
home.

Private transportation will be arranged for a smooth, stress-free departure.

Slán go fóill — until we meet again.

included: Experience at the Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge
Two free days to explore at your own pace
notIncluded: Airfare from the US to Ireland Airport Dublin (DUB)
Optional excursions and tours not listed above
Tips or gratuity for personal items
